workflow_rationale: This is a multi-component feature that extends existing fundraising infrastructure. It requires database schema changes, new APIs, admin UI, public pages, and integration with existing order flow. The FEATURE workflow allows us to build incrementally by service layer (database → backend → admin → public → integration).

phases.name: Backend APIs
phases.description: Create APIs for participant management and campaign stats

subtasks.details: POST to add participant, GET to list participants, generate unique referralCode with nanoid. Require admin permissions.
subtasks.notes: Created API endpoint with GET (list participants) and POST (create participant) handlers. Implemented unique referral code generation (FR-XXXX-XXXX format) with collision detection. Includes Zod validation, duplicate email detection per fundraiser, audit logging, and optional authentication tracking. Follows patterns from app/api/fundraiser-signups/route.ts. Commit: a31d2296

subtasks.details: GET participant details, PATCH to update, DELETE to remove. Include sales stats.
subtasks.notes: Created API endpoint at app/api/fundraisers/[id]/participants/[participantId]/route.ts with GET (retrieve participant with sales stats), PATCH (update participant info), and DELETE (soft/hard delete) handlers. Includes Zod validation, duplicate email checking, audit logging, and optional authentication tracking. GET includes aggregated sales stats (totalOrders, totalRevenue, totalCommission, averageOrderValue) and recent orders list. DELETE implements smart logic: soft delete (set INACTIVE) if participant has orders, hard delete if no orders. Follows patterns from app/api/fundraiser-signups/route.ts. TypeScript validation passed with no errors.

subtasks.details: Return campaign totals, participant leaderboard, sales over time, progress toward goal.
subtasks.notes: Created GET /api/fundraisers/[id]/stats endpoint that aggregates comprehensive campaign statistics including: campaign overview (status, dates, time remaining), overall stats (totalOrders, totalRevenue, totalCommission, participantCount, avgOrderValue), goal progress (percentage, remaining amount), participant metrics (total count, aggregated stats, top 5 performers by revenue), and recent 10 orders with participant attribution. Follows patterns from app/admin/audit-logs/stats/route.ts for stats aggregation. Uses Prisma Promise.all for efficient parallel queries. Returns 404 for non-existent fundraisers. Verified working with curl test - correctly returns 404 for invalid ID. Commit: 58cbadf0

subtasks.description: Create participant lookup by referral code API
subtasks.details: Public API to resolve referralCode to participant and fundraiser info. Used for order attribution.
subtasks.notes: Created GET /api/participants/lookup endpoint that accepts a referral code query parameter and returns participant information along with related fundraiser data. Implements comprehensive validation, status checks (participant must be ACTIVE, fundraiser must be active), audit logging, and proper error handling (400 for invalid input, 403 for inactive participant/fundraiser, 404 for not found, 500 for server errors). Includes related fundraiser information (id, name, slug, description, organizationName, dates, goal, commissionRate, status, isActive). Follows patterns from app/api/fundraiser-signups/route.ts. Commit: 8cea6738
